whatsNew.title: What's New in SD Tech Imports

2026-11-preorder.title: Sell to order
2026-11-preorder.description: Mark a product as “Sold to order” and you can charge for it at the register even with no stock. Those units show as “to deliver” until the purchase arrives.

2026-11-imports.title: Dollar purchases and orders on the way
2026-11-imports.description: Record your Amazon purchases in dollars: the app converts them to pesos with today's rate (or the rate you paid) and adds shipping. Anything still in transit shows on the home screen until you mark it as received.

2026-11-receipt-qr.title: Receipts with a verifiable QR
2026-11-receipt-qr.description: Every receipt carries a QR. Anyone who scans it can see whether the receipt is authentic.
